requirements.source_excerpt: All valves shall be proof tested to a minimum pneumatic proof pressure at 1.5xMEOP.
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: Every valve shall undergo pneumatic proof testing at a pressure of at least 1.5 times MEOP.
canonical_constraints: For every valve: pneumatic proof-test pressure >= 1.5 × MEOP.

requirements.source_excerpt: demonstrated on every unit during assembly, with pressure applied individually to each line
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: The proof-pressure capability shall be demonstrated on every unit during assembly by separately pressurizing each line and the valve housing through the actuation ram chamber while lines are vented.
canonical_constraints: For every unit during assembly: apply pressure individually to each line.
For every unit during assembly: separately apply pressure to the valve housing through the actuation ram chamber while the lines are vented.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies to every unit during assembly.

requirements.source_excerpt: The test shall be performed on all parent metal shear-section and all parts of the valve
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: The test shall cover every parent-metal shear-section and every valve part exposed to pressure after valve actuation.
canonical_constraints: Test all valve parts exposed to pressure after valve actuation.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Covers all parent-metal shear-sections and all valve parts exposed to pressure after actuation.

requirements.source_excerpt: All welds shall be leak tested either during assembly or acceptance testing.
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: Every weld shall be leak tested either during assembly or during acceptance testing.
canonical_constraints: For all welds: leak testing shall occur during assembly OR acceptance testing.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies to all welds; either stated test stage is permitted.

requirements.source_excerpt: Either non-destructive acceptance testing shall be accomplished or the risk of defects be mitigated through process control.
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: Defect risk shall be addressed by either performing non-destructive acceptance testing or mitigating defect risk through process control.
canonical_constraints: Perform non-destructive acceptance testing OR mitigate defect risk through process control.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: One of the two stated alternatives is required.

requirements.source_excerpt: If process control is used, approval shall be obtained from the NASA Fracture Control Board
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: If process control is used, NASA Fracture Control Board approval shall be obtained for spacecraft requiring such approval in programmatic requirements.
canonical_constraints: IF process control is used AND programmatic requirements require this approval for the spacecraft, THEN obtain NASA Fracture Control Board approval.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Conditional on use of process control and applicability of the programmatic approval requirement.

requirements.source_excerpt: growth of the maximum credible crack size shall be demonstrated to the fracture control authority
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: When fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis is used to verify NASA-STD-5019 compliance, demonstrate to the fracture control authority that growth of the maximum credible crack size is non-credible, based on relevant quality-control and manufacturing knowledge.
canonical_constraints: IF fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis are used to verify NASA-STD-5019 compliance, THEN demonstrate to the fracture control authority that growth of the maximum credible crack size is non-credible.
Base the demonstration on knowledge of quality-control and manufacturing techniques used to make the valve.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies only if fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis are used for NASA-STD-5019 compliance verification.

requirements.source_excerpt: the NC parent metal valve shall be capable of surviving four times the design operational life.
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: Regardless of how the capability is technically established, the NC parent-metal valve shall be capable of surviving at least four times its design operational life.
canonical_constraints: Valve survival capability >= 4 × design operational life.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies regardless of the technical method used to establish capability.

requirements.source_excerpt: verified by proof testing at 1.5xMEOP, independently applied to each parent metal shear-section
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: If a valve design provides two separate and independent parent-metal barriers to flow before actuation, verify that capability through 1.5×MEOP proof testing independently applied to each shear-section and then externally after welding in the housing, with no permanent deformation or leakage during LAT.
canonical_constraints: IF the valve design provides two separate and independent parent-metal barriers before actuation, THEN apply proof pressure >= 1.5 × MEOP independently to each parent-metal shear-section.
Then apply the proof test externally to the shear-section when welded in the housing.
During LAT: no evidence of permanent deformation AND no leakage.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies only to designs intended to provide two separate and independent parent-metal barriers before actuation.

requirements.source_excerpt: The minimum hold time for each burst pressure test shall be 5 min.
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: Each burst-pressure test shall have a hold time of at least 5 minutes.
canonical_constraints: For each burst-pressure test: hold time >= 5 min.

requirements.source_excerpt: minimum design burst pressure of 2.5xMEOP for lines with diameters ≥3.8 cm
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: All NC parent-metal valves shall meet a minimum design burst pressure of at least 2.5×MEOP for lines with diameter at least 3.8 cm (1.5 in), or at least 4.0×MEOP for lines with diameter below 3.8 cm (1.5 in).
canonical_constraints: IF line diameter >= 3.8 cm (>= 1.5 in), THEN minimum design burst pressure >= 2.5 × MEOP.
IF line diameter < 3.8 cm (< 1.5 in), THEN minimum design burst pressure >= 4.0 × MEOP.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies to all NC parent-metal valves; applicable threshold depends on line diameter.

requirements.source_excerpt: This capability shall be demonstrated on at least one NC parent metal valve from each lot.
requirements.canonical_engineering_meaning: The applicable NCPR 28 burst-pressure capability shall be demonstrated on at least one NC parent-metal valve from each lot.
canonical_constraints: For each valve lot: number of NC parent-metal valves demonstrating the applicable burst-pressure capability >= 1.
